buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 2. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 3. Generic

Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Generic Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only. 5. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 6. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Payment online through RTGS / internet banking also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name BHARAT DYNAMIC LIMITED Account No. 104531043010001 IFSC Code UBIN0810452 Bank Name UNION BANK OF INDIA Branch address BDL CAMPUS BRANCH, KANCHANABAGH, HYDERABAD, TELANGANA-500058 . Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer in place of PBG within 15 days of award of contract. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Items to be supplied as per list of deliverables at Annexure - A. 2. Items at Sl.no. 01 to 09 to be supplied as per specifications at Annexure - 01 to 09. 3. Items to be supplied along with test reports, calibration reports and detailed user manual. 4. Spares: All applicable spares to be provided along with the item. 5. Inspection agency: The items will be inspected by BDL (QC). 6. Delivery Period: The items to be supplied within 08 months from the date of receipt of PO, to BDL (VU), at free of cost. 8. Warranty Clause: The vendor should provide warranty for 12 months from the date of acceptance of the items. 9. Packing Condition: The items to be supplied in good packing condition and should conform to ISO stand

ards. 10.Payment terms: 95% basic 100 % taxes within 30 days after receipt, acceptance of PO items BDL- VU, a nd remaining 5% basic against submission of PBG (performance bank guarantee valid till warranty period + claim period of 3 months). 11. BDL- vu reserves its right to release GST only after supplier's invoice/debit note is reflected in GSTR- 2 b/2a within the specified time limit mentioned in GST law. 12. LD clause: Time is the essence of the P.O and delivery should be strictly insisted upon according to the delivery sched ule given in the SOs/POs. In the event the supplier fails to deliver the goods/ service, within the stipulated delivery period, BDL reserves the right to recover from the supplier, LD and not by way of penalty an amou nt as detailed in terms and conditions. A sum of 0.5% of the price only of the stores (including duties, taxes ) which the supplier has failed to deliver as aforesaid for each week of delay or part thereof, subject to a m aximum of 10%. In case of extension of delivery period, increase in taxes shall not be borne by BDL, if dela y is attributable to vendor. 13. As 9100D clause: I) supplier shall not supply non-conforming product against specification. Ii) supplier shall notify BDL of non-conforming processes, products or services and obtain approval for their disposition (i.e. rework, rejection etc.,). Iii) supplier shall notify BDL of changes to manufacturing processes, products or services including change s of their external providers or location of manufacture and obtain BDL approval. Iv) supplier shall retain the product related records (processes, quality records etc.,) up to 3 years. V) BDL, its customer and regulatory authorities having right of access to the applicable areas of all your fac ilities, at any level of supply chain, involved in our order and all applicable records. Vi) supplier shall ensure that the persons carrying out the manufacturing of items under this purchase orde r be aware of product conformity requirements, product safety and importance of ethical behaviour etc. Vii) wherever drawing revisions are applicable, old drawings are to be returned to BDL or to be destroyed with an intimation to BDL. Viii) wherever applicable, esd controls to be followed for pcb and other electronics items. Ix) in case of any corrective action plan against non-conforming product reported/identified at any stage th e same shall be brought to the notice of BDL for approval before its implementation. X) supplier shall not use any suspected/detected counterfeit parts" during any stage of manufacturing. Xi) counterfeit parts shall not be supplied to BDL. If any counterfeit parts are received, severe action shall be initiated against the supplier. Xii) vendor shall comply ISO 14001:2015 ems for the PO. 14. BDL will not acknowledge receipt of goods or service as a valid supply/ service, until all mandatory doc uments listed in purchase Order (e.g., inspection report, free issue material consumption report, warranty certificate, ePBG, GST invoice) are provided. A checklist of submitted documents is required with each sup ply. 15. The vendor participating in the tender should declare if demerged in the recent times, to declare the m erge, nature of demerger for the assessment of the credentials for acceptance of your quotations, falling o n which knowing of the demerger in the later stage by BDL, BDL will entitle the vendor for debarment. 16. The bidders should submit the compliance statement for acceptance of all terms & conditions, accepta nce of attached specifications for the said bid 17. The successful bidder should submit security deposit for 5% of the order value after placement of orde r. .
